papers.title: Enhancing Supply Chain Visibility with Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
papers.depth: 2024 preprint methods and evaluation read; later publisher excerpt checked
papers.finding: EV/Wikipedia extraction evaluation uses 1,277 sentences. It evaluates extracted triples, not empirical supply-chain truth; missed-triple recall/F-scores not assessed. Supplies-to accuracy reported 0.71.
papers.application: LLM-assisted candidate extraction can preserve typed edges/locators. Require documentary verification before merging or using supply links in product verdicts.
papers.limits: Not a benchmark for Chinese consumer goods, live supplier truth or DropShredder. No replication performed.

papers.title: Building A Knowledge Graph to Enrich ChatGPT Responses in Manufacturing Service Discovery
papers.finding: Describes North-American small-manufacturer discovery and a dataset of over 13,000 manufacturer links/services/certification/location entity types.
papers.application: Ontology and retrieval design lead; locality/certification must be source-scoped.
papers.limits: Not evidence of current Chinese factory identity, reliability or retail product quality; dataset/code/license not audited.
